input.subject: 8 Brackenmere Walk – washer-dryer replacement
input.body:
Address: 8 Brackenmere Walk, Vellumford, ZZ1 1ZZ

Hi Ari,

Thank you for your email. Yes, the change is still happening. Your landlord has ordered a new washing machine and has arranged for it to be delivered and fitted, and for the old machine to be taken away. We do not have a delivery date yet. We have asked your landlord for it and will let you know as soon as we hear.

So that we have the right picture, can you please confirm whether the new machine has now been delivered and fitted, or whether you are still waiting for it? When we spoke yesterday you said nothing had arrived yet.

Also, are you happy for us to pass your phone number to your landlord's delivery and installation company so they can arrange the delivery with you directly?

Kind regards
Northbridge Lettings

input.subject: 8 Brackenmere Walk – new washing machine delivery
input.body:
Address: 8 Brackenmere Walk, Vellumford, ZZ1 1ZZ

Hello Nessa,

Thank you for arranging the new washing machine, along with its delivery, fitting and the removal of the old one. When we spoke to the tenant yesterday, Wednesday 24 September, the new machine had not yet arrived. Can you please let us know the delivery and installation date, and the name of the company doing it, so we can make sure the tenant is ready to give access? The tenant has asked for at least three hours' notice before anyone attends.

If the installers would like to contact the tenant directly, we have asked the tenant if they are happy for us to share their number and will pass it on once they agree.

Kind regards
Northbridge Lettings

input.decision: Stage: the landlord is replacing the machine through her own route. She ordered a new washing machine and arranged its delivery, fitting and the removal of the old one herself (events 027 and 029), with no date given. PM-AUTH-004 applies: the agency sends no contractor of its own. The tenant's "Yes, the job is completed" in event 031 conflicts with their call in event 030, where they said nothing had arrived, and in the same email they ask whether the change is still happening. So the job is not confirmed done and cannot be closed (PM-CLOSE-001, PM-DOC-001). I have emailed the tenant to say the replacement is still going ahead, ask whether the machine has actually been delivered and fitted, and ask for consent to share their number with the landlord's installers (PM-PRIV-001). I have emailed the landlord asking for the delivery and installation date and the installer's name, and passed on the tenant's request for three hours' notice (event 013). The case is on hold, Waiting for Landlord, until 29/09/2025. Next: if the landlord gives a date, tell the tenant and keep holding until the installation. When the tenant or landlord confirms it is installed, complete without payment. If either of them stays silent, chase on 29/09.
input.summaryForHuman: The landlord ordered a replacement washer-dryer and is arranging delivery and fitting herself. The tenant has sent mixed messages ("job completed", but nothing had arrived yesterday). I have emailed the tenant to clarify and the landlord for the delivery date, and the case is on hold until 29/09.
